# Yamini Enterprises

> Exclusive Dealers and Service Providers for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur. Established in 2009, Yamini Enterprises specializes in Hitachi HVAC products and services, primarily serving Jodhpur, with project operations extending across Rajasthan. We are committed to providing reliable air-conditioning solutions for a wide range of applications.

In short: Yamini Enterprises is the exclusive dealer and service provider for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, for Hitachi air conditioner sales, its Hitachi showroom, installation, annual maintenance (AMC) and repairs.

## Services
- Sales & supply: As exclusive dealers for Hitachi HVAC Solutions, we supply the complete range for homes, businesses and large projects.
- Installation & commissioning: Correct installation decides how well an AC cools and how long it lasts. Our technicians install, test and hand over every unit.
- Annual maintenance (AMC): Scheduled preventive servicing keeps efficiency high and breakdowns rare, for homes, commercial buildings and large facilities.
- Repairs & breakdowns: Not cooling, leaking or making noise? Our service team diagnoses and fixes the problem.
- Central AC projects: VRF, ductable and chiller-based systems for hotels, resorts, hospitals, commercial buildings, offices and industrial facilities, across Rajasthan.
- Advice & system selection: Tell us about your space and requirement, and we'll recommend the right Hitachi system, residential, commercial or institutional.

- [Inverter Split ACs](https://yaminient.in/products/inverter-split-acs/): 22 models. Energy-saving inverter splits for homes and offices. KASHIKOI, MERAI, SUGOI, ACE, LOGICOOL, TOUSHI and TAKESHI series.
- [Fixed Speed Split ACs](https://yaminient.in/products/fixed-speed-split-acs/): 9 models. Dependable, budget-friendly cooling for every room. TAKESHI, ZUNOH and LOGICOOL series.
- [Window ACs](https://yaminient.in/products/window-acs/): 11 models. Compact single-unit cooling that installs in a window. SUMMER, KAZE REIDAN, KAZE PLUS and KAZE PLUS ECO series.
- [Cassette & Concealed ACs](https://yaminient.in/products/light-commercial-air-conditioners/): 14 models. Light commercial cooling for shops, clinics and offices. Cassette, concealed and Flexi split air conditioners.
- [Ductable ACs](https://yaminient.in/products/ductable-air-conditioners/): 26 models. Ducted cooling for halls, showrooms and large floors. Toushi and Takumi ranges, 5.5 TR to 16.5 TR.
- [VRF Systems](https://yaminient.in/products/vrf-systems/): 21 models. Central air for buildings with many zones. Set Free outdoor units, indoor units and central controllers.
- [Chillers](https://yaminient.in/products/hitachi-chillers/): 3 models. Plant-scale cooling for hospitals, malls and industry. Air-cooled screw, water-cooled screw and centrifugal chillers.
- [Portable & Other ACs](https://yaminient.in/products.html?cat=ac): 2 models. Plug-and-play and other cooling options. Portable air conditioners and more.

## Frequently asked questions
### Is Yamini Enterprises an authorised Hitachi dealer in Jodhpur?
Yes. Yamini Enterprises is the exclusive dealer and service provider for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur, and an authorised sale and service dealer for Hitachi air conditioners since 2009.

### Which Hitachi AC works best in Jodhpur's summer heat?
Jodhpur summers regularly cross 45°C, so choose a model built for high outdoor temperatures. Hitachi's ductable ACs (Toushi and Takumi), concealed splits and Set Free Sigma VRF systems are listed to work up to 52°C, and the home split range uses Hitachi's Tropical or Expandable Inverter technology. Tell us where the outdoor unit will sit and we'll recommend the right model.

### Where is your showroom?
Our Hitachi showroom is at 134, R.K. Nagar, Opp. B.R. Birla Public School, Jodhpur, Rajasthan 342008. Visit to compare Hitachi models side by side.

### How do I book AC service or a repair?
Call +91 94141 00877 or send us the details on WhatsApp, with a photo of the unit's model sticker if you can. We handle installation, annual maintenance (AMC), gas refilling and repairs for Hitachi units.

### Which AC capacity (tonnage) do I need?
It depends on room size, sun exposure, number of people and appliances. As a rough guide, small bedrooms often need about 1 ton and larger living rooms 1.5–2 tons, but we recommend talking to our team so we can size it correctly.

### Inverter or fixed speed: which should I buy?
Inverter ACs adjust their speed to the cooling needed, so they use less electricity and keep the temperature steadier. They cost more upfront but usually save money if you run the AC for many hours a day. Fixed speed models suit lighter or occasional use.

### Do you handle installation?
Yes. Our technicians handle installation, piping, drainage, electrical connections, testing and a demo.

### What warranty do I get?
All products carry the Hitachi manufacturer's warranty, purchased through Yamini Enterprises as the exclusive dealer in Jodhpur. Ask us for the warranty terms of your model.

### Which areas do you serve?
We primarily serve Jodhpur, and take on HVAC projects across Rajasthan.

### Can you supply in bulk for projects or dealers?
Yes. Alongside individual customers, we handle large-scale projects for hotels, resorts, hospitals, commercial buildings, offices and industrial facilities. Contact us with your requirement for a quotation.
